claim.quote: The existence of a light dark force mediator has been tested with the KLOE detector at DAPHNE. This particle, called U, is searched for using the decay chain phi-->etaU, eta-->pi+pi-pi0, U-->e+e-. No evidence is found in 1.5 fb-1 of data.

date.locator: arXiv abstract page, submission date (arXiv:1110.0411 v1, 3 October 2011)
date.note: arXiv submission date; published in Phys. Lett. B 706, 251 (2012).

key_value_text.quote: setting an upper limit on the ratio between the U boson coupling constant and the fine structure constant, alpha'/alpha, of <= 2x10^-5 at 90% C.L. for 50<M_U<420 MeV
key_value_text.value: α′/α ≤ 2×10⁻⁵ at 90% C.L. for 50 < M_U < 420 MeV (exclusion for 5 < M_U < 470 MeV)

name: Search for a vector gauge boson in phi meson decays with the KLOE detector
notes: The arXiv listing credits the KLOE-2 Collaboration (author field); the data are KLOE data (1.5 fb^-1) and the result is attributed to experiment:kloe.

summary.plain: KLOE looked for a hypothetical light force-carrying particle, called U, produced in phi-meson decays and decaying to an electron-positron pair. It found no evidence in 1.5 inverse femtobarns of data and set limits on how strongly such a particle could couple.
summary.technical: KLOE: search for a light dark-force mediator U via φ → ηU, η → π⁺π⁻π⁰, U → e⁺e⁻ with 1.5 fb⁻¹: no evidence; exclusion for 5 < M_U < 470 MeV and α′/α ≤ 2×10⁻⁵ at 90% C.L. for 50 < M_U < 420 MeV.

title: Search for a vector gauge boson in phi meson decays with the KLOE detector
why_it_matters: CERN Courier lists searches for dark photons among the physics results of the KLOE data.
